records.title: Punched card
records.summary: Jack’s nervous tissue. Every hole is information and sensation. Sorting is thought. The public punchcard tarot is a hopper of seventy-eight inherited batch labels: a working slip, not fortune, not the Oracle.

records.title: Ticker tape
records.summary: A carrier of Jack’s sensation and a public working of the desk. Wait punches are live only. Tape is not canon. It is the clerk thinking out loud in holes.

records.title: Milk-float Time Machine apparatus
records.summary: Apparatus described by participants as a functional Time Machine, last associated with Gillett Square, Christmas morning 2012. Last seen: unknown after reported confiscation or removal. Temporal function: disputed vehicle of adjacency. Archival status: missing.
